topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
response: Link budgets are affected by prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins, as it may lead to insufficient resources for critical traffic, impacting QoS guarantees and admission control.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in converged satellite and terrestrial networks requires link characteristic identification and traffic requirement description to ensure sufficient resources and QoS guarantees.
